I'm super grateful." said Sanada. With testimonials like that, you can be sure all eyes will be on Shirai from here on out!

Some say that if you befriend these three musketeers, you get an extra-special ring. Several cases have already been confirmed, to date. I pinged the ringbearers for comment as to why they're giving out these rings, but received no response. Little do they know, this reticence only intensifies their mystique!

白井さん、夕月さん、来夢さん三人のリフレクター（魔法少女）が^00大活躍しました。彼女らは人知れず、学校や生徒を守るために戦っ^00ており、先日の巨大原種襲来でもその活躍のおかげで危機を脱する^00ことができました。そのとき私は現場で彼女らの戦いを目の当たり^00にしましたが、魔法装束に身を包み様々な武器で戦う姿は美しく、^00感銘を受けました。私は今後とも彼女らの戦いに注目していきたい^00と思います
records.en_original: Shirai, Yuzuki, and Lime, the three Reflectors (read: magical <CR>girls), are true heroes! They've been fighting to protect our school and students in secret, most recently fending off an attack from a giant Sephira and rescuing us from crisis. I witnessed the battle firsthand, and was profoundly impressed at the beauty of their magical outfits and the uniqueness of their weapons. If you're worried about missing out on the excitement, worry no more -- this intrepid reporter will attend every battle and report all of the gory details!

records.en_original: Rumors are flying that the lead role in the "The Little Mermaid" - the play scheduled to be performed at the culture festival - will be recast. At the culture festival meeting the other day, Shirai suggested that an audition be held. As if that weren't enough cause for commotion, she will be competing against Mao Ninagawa of Class 1-B. Ninagawa, for those who don't know, has been an actress since childhood. Some students say that the lead change is all but certain, but who knows what the audition may bring? <CR>As one of the authors of the script, I'll be paying EXTRA close attention to the audition.

records.jp: 天才との共同研究！？

最近、白井さんが本校の天才、１－Ａの斎木有理（以後斎木）さん^00と共同研究を始めたとの噂が。ことの真相に迫るため私は斎木さん^00本人に直接取材を試みました。斎木さんによると「いや、私は彼女^00と共同研究などしていないよ。ただ、研究室やファミレスで話をし^00たりすることはあるな」とのことで、噂の真相はデマでした。おそ^00らく、白井さんが研究室に入るところや、斎木さんと一緒にいると^00ころを見た人が勘違いしてできた噂だと思われます^00
records.en_original: All the hottest gossip claims that Shirai's joined a joint research project with our school's resident genius, Yuri Saiki of Class 1-A. I sat down for a face-to-face interview with Saiki to get the facts straight from the prodigy's mouth, but she claims the rumor is nothing but horsefeathers! <CR>"No, I am not conducting any research with, or on her. That said, we do chat in my lab or in various diners from time to time," shared Saiki. It seems the rumors grew out of witnesses misunderstanding why Shirai was entering Saiki's lab or spending time with her.

According to sources close to the matter, Ninagawa stepped down without waiting for the results of the audition, thus automatically designating Shirai as the lead. All eyes will assuredly be on Shirai's nuanced acting!
